messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: High 5xx error-rate on /v1/generate (eu-west1). 5m rate = 14.2% > threshold. pd-bot: Alert routed to oncall-sre rotation. Escalation level 1.
sara: acked. investigating.
kevin: I'm on it, pulling logs from ingress. seeing a surge of 502s from upstream auth-proxy.
jordan: I see increased latency between gateway -> inference-proxy too, KV-cache evictions around same time. could be correlated.
sara: checklist: confirm customer impact, identify active rollouts, check autoscale.
mike: support reporting 3 customers with errors via tickets. flagging for business.
kevin: tailing logs: auth-proxy 502s spike ~ 10:03 UTC, connection resets to inference pool. snippet: ```auth-proxy ERROR: upstream 502 connect reset (conn_id=0x3f2)```
sara: is this a gateway routing issue or downstream model hosts?
kevin: initial hypothesis: upstream auth-proxy overload causing 502 fanout.
jordan: but inference pods show increased 5xx for /generate as well, and KV cache miss rate doubled. maybe a small rollout increased payload sizes.
sara: rolling check: any canary or model deploy in last 30m?
jordan: yes, there was a dark-launch for tokenizer-service at 09:56 UTC (small traffic slice). rolling back now.
kevin: prefiring quick mitigation: enable fallback route to older auth-proxy pool (runbook step 3). link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/5xx-fallback-routing
sara: doing fallback now.
pd-bot: note: escalation timer paused by ack.
mike: customer impact: 3 enterprise tenants experiencing ~30% failed requests, some more sensitive partners.
sara: submitted status page draft: "Partial service degradation for generation in eu-west1, working on mitigation".
jordan: rolling rollback of tokenizer-service confirmed. waiting 30s to observe.
kevin: after fallback, 5xx rate dropped to 3.4% in 1m window. monitoring.
sara: good improvement. will keep open for handoff until stable.
pd-bot: will auto-escalate if 5xx > 5% for 10m.
sara: i'll leave detailed notes in the incident log and hand off to morning oncall at 08:00 local.
mike: adding customer ticket updates. :thumbsup:
incidentbot: Incident recorded: INC-2026-0458. attachments: brief timeline, mitigation actions.
sara: thanks all, moving to postmortem draft after stabilization.
kevin: leaving link to brief logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/query?id=abc123.
jordan: post-rollback metrics look healthy, KV miss back to normal.
sara: last check: traffic normalized, closing alert in 10m unless it repros.
